WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    orders.status AS "orders.status"
  FROM orders AS orders
  GROUP BY
    orders.status
), _cm_orders__customers__credit_sum AS (
  SELECT
    _base."orders__status" AS "orders__status",
    CAST(SUM(_base._v) AS DOUBLE) AS "credit_sum_host"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      orders.status AS "orders__status",
      customers.customer_pk AS _ek0,
      MAX(customers.credit) AS _v
    FROM customers AS customers
    LEFT JOIN orders AS orders
      ON customers.customer_pk = orders.cust_fk
    WHERE
      NOT customers.customer_pk IS NULL
    GROUP BY
      orders.status,
      customers.customer_pk
  ) AS _base
  GROUP BY
    _base."orders__status"
)
SELECT
  _base."orders.status",
  _cm_orders__customers__credit_sum."credit_sum_host" AS "cr"
FROM _base
LEFT JOIN _cm_orders__customers__credit_sum
  ON _base."orders.status" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_orders__customers__credit_sum."orders__status"
ORDER BY
  _base."orders.status" ASC

on_clause/renamed_both_two_hops::duckdb:
SELECT
  customers.__slayer_d0 AS "customers.regions.name",
  CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "amt"
FROM orders AS orders
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    customers.customer_pk AS customer_pk,
    customers__regions.name AS __slayer_d0
  FROM customers AS customers
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      customers__regions.region_pk AS region_pk,
      customers__regions.name AS name
    FROM regions AS customers__regions
  ) AS customers__regions
    ON customers.region_fk = customers__regions.region_pk
) AS customers
  ON orders.cust_fk = customers.customer_pk
GROUP BY
  customers.__slayer_d0
ORDER BY
  "customers.regions.name" ASC
